agent.reasons: The listed stakes add up to 100%. Delta Holdings LLC (17%) is fully owned by Vera Fofana, so her indirect stake is 17%. That means Elif Silva (55%) is the only person who owns 25% or more, and she is identified and verified. She is also the control person (CEO), and every listed individual passed the identity check. The registry filing (2026-04-17) is about 6 months old, under the 12-month limit. Sanctions, PEP and adverse-media checks are clear for the entity and all individuals, the industry is normal, and all parties are in the US. No risk factor applies, so the case is approved.
